programme.title: The Face Doctors

programme.desc: S02 E12 — Adventures in Pimplepopping Inoke has a huge, possibly life-threatening bulge on his shoulder; Delano returns with his back lump after Dr. Lee removed a liter of fluid from it; Reed has hundreds of bumps on his chest that burst and leave nasty scars.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Leave It to Nevus With pandemic safety protocols in place, Dr. Lee reopens her office; Monica has a large birthmark growing on the side of her face; Jackie has a melon-sized lump on the back of her shoulder; Reginald has large, rare growths on the back of his head.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S05 E19 — California Bumpin' Brent has a tricep bump potentially intertwined in his muscle; Jeb loves the beach but refuses to go because of the massive number of blackheads, pimples, and cysts all over his body; Wanda's mysterious mark that caves in her side.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S02 E01 — I'm Gonna Be a Problem Natalie and her bedridden mother, Felicia, have been plagued with obesity for most of their lives; Dr. Procter vows to give them both weight loss surgery if Natalie can lose weight and Felicia can walk again.
programme.title: Dangerously Obese

programme.desc: S02 E05 — The Baddie Inside Niki's softball career is cut short by her obesity; she wants to relive her dreams by coaching her son, but her food addiction threatens her ability to live her dreams and get bariatric surgery.
programme.title: Dangerously Obese

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Skin in the Game Mahfuza and Nelly are living with Harlequin ichthyosis, one of the world's rarest and most severe skin conditions; Mahfuza prepares for her first boxing match; Nelly fully supports her friend but worries that the high risks may outweigh the rewards.
programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Bending the Rules In Indonesia, Dimas dreams of becoming a martial arts warrior, but his family worries the training will harm his oddly bendy body; in Colombia, Herson's backward-bending knees are failing, and he questions his dream of proposing to his girlfriend.
programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.desc: S11 E06 — Sleepover Nightmare A young boy at a sleepover party mysteriously loses control over his arms and legs; a woman is shot in the leg at her own bachelorette party; bubbles in a woman's arteries are causing a stroke.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S10 E05 — Medieval Mayhem A man injured in a medieval role playing battle has a sword impaled in his head; a critically ill patient is so afraid of germs he won't allow doctors to treat him; two patients with the same life-threatening symptoms.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S10 E02 — Zombie Uprising A Halloween zombie with a problem below the belt mystifies doctors; two unconscious men are involved in an accident, a doctor makes a mistake that amazingly explains a patient's condition.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S10 E07 — Beyond Recognition A man's face and body suddenly double in size; a young woman is burning up from the inside out after a day at the beach; a grumpy old man nearly dies before revealing an emotional secret.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S01 E07 — The Girl With Two Uteruses Gianna reveals her shock at finding out that she has two uteruses; Lindsay retells the story of an alligator feeding gone wrong; Hannah and Ethan's dance moves leave Hannah facing paralysis; Nick shares the heroic story of saving five siblings.
programme.title: ER: Caught on Camera
